hypothesis: three competent local evaluators disagree substantially on the same real code diffs (pairwise agreement < 0.8, with at least one ship/no-ship flip case)

kill_switch.note: evaluator dependence is deployment-relevant: extend to 20+ diffs + frontier evaluator for the breadth claim
high agreement: evaluator choice does not move ship decisions on this diff set

tension: Teams route diffs through whichever LLM reviewer is cheapest, assuming evaluator choice is cosmetic. No measurement exists of whether three competent evaluators reach the same ship/no-ship decisions on the same diffs. If they diverge, every unevaluated reviewer choice is an uncontrolled experiment on production code.
